items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ray Blue with me this afternoon... >> [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you. Thank you very much, Monk, it’s a pleasure to be here.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Ray Blue with me this afternoon, connecting from Peekskill to Clinton, New York. Welcome, Ray.
Thank you. Thank you very much, Monk, it’s a pleasure to be here.
I remember fondly your visit to Hamilton and I’ve been recently listening to some of your recordings and I want to say I very much dig your sound.
